sweeps.name: topology-ep
sweeps.narrative: Mid-width tp4 instances should win at the SLO, and EP should matter little at dp 1 but cost throughput once dp spreads experts wider.

sweeps.name: batch-tokens
sweeps.narrative: The per-step token cap should bind harder on four wide instances than on eight narrow ones, since long agentic prompts concentrate per instance.

sweeps.name: prefill-chunking
sweeps.narrative: Capping prefill chunks should cost throughput at both widths, more where fewer decodes share each instance's token budget.

sweeps.name: kv-capacity
sweeps.narrative: nvfp4 KV and a higher memory fraction both buy cache, so on a prefix-heavy replay they should substitute rather than add.

sweeps.name: moe-collective
sweeps.narrative: A DeepEP backend should beat the allgather default at EP 16, and the gap should shrink or flip at EP 4.

sweeps.name: drafting
sweeps.narrative: dspark should raise throughput more on narrow instances, while K=5 may push wide shapes past the 20ms ITL floor.

sweeps.name: routing-prefix-cache
sweeps.narrative: Prefix-affinity with caching on should lead and random with caching off trail, and the gap should widen from four instances to eight.

sweeps.name: cudagraph
sweeps.narrative: Full capture should edge out the PIECEWISE default by a few percent.

objective: max output tok/s per GPU subject to the scenario's SLOs
